text:
Lena (Finance): Uploaded the AB pricing workbook. Variant 1 = +5% per-token + dev credits; Variant 2 = flat price, bigger free tier. Need final on grandfathering length and whether to allow sales overrides. sheet: https://drive.redwood/pricing/ab-1753000456
Raj (Sales): Prefer Variant 1 for ARR upsell. Concern: PLG churn.
Miles (FinAnalyst): Quick est: V1 ~+$52k MRR, V2 ~+$11k MRR (month 1). Assumptions in sheet.
Kim (Ops): Billing note: Stripe will auto-prorate for standard subs; ~85 legacy metered accounts need manual credits. Will publish runbook.
billing-bot: Auto-proration supported for standard plans; legacy metered flagged for manual. See internal/billing/proration.
Ellen (Legal): Need a short amendment for grandfathered customers + 30d notice. Annual contracts excluded unless consented.
Raj (Sales): Sales overrides okay, but please flag in CRM so billing skips migration.
Hector (EngOps): Rollout plan: feature-flag canary 3% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100%. Circuit breaker if billing error rate >0.4%.
Lena (Finance): Proposed grandfathering: 90 days standard, 180 days for partners. Approvals needed: Sales + Legal + Ops.
Ellen (Legal): Can sign off pending exact wording. Send me the text.
Raj (Sales): Approve Variant 1 + 90/180 split pending legal.
Kim (Ops): Ops can deliver runbook and account list by Thursday COB.
Hector (EngOps): I'll schedule the canary next Tue morning. Will link ticket here.
Lena (Finance): Thanks team. If any Stripe edge-cases surface, flag here so finance can coordinate manual refunds/credits. :white_check_mark:
